title: FIRST LOOK: Elves Vanyar Pro Disc. Is it a Budget Specialized Tarmac?

takeaways.text: A UK after-sales office handles custom builds and warranty for the UK and Europe, and the frameset carries a five-year warranty.
Elves describes the second generation as a lightweight climbing bike with some aero: a claimed 40 s saving over 40 km at 40 km/h and more head-tube stiffness than the first generation.
The claimed frame weight is 950 g for size 56; the UK frameset price was £858, or £4,000 for the Ultegra Di2 complete build shown, with 8–10 week delivery from China.
It is spaced for up to 30 mm tires front and rear and comes with 28 mm, uses a BB386 press-fit bottom bracket with ceramic bearings, and has a short head tube for a low position.
The size-56 Ultegra Di2 showcase build weighed 7.6 kg without pedals.

disclosure: Elves's UK office built the size-56 showcase bike with Ultegra Di2 and Elves parts for review. The launch-day video shows the second-generation Vanyar Pro Disc that the candidate lists as the 2024 frameset.
summary: Launch-day first look at the second-generation Elves Vanyar Pro Disc as a UK complete build.
